result.title: VascuSR: Iterative Anatomy-Aware Diffusion for CT Super-Resolution
result.summary: Generative super-resolution (SR) can recover sharp detail in computed tomography (CT) images from severely downsampled observations, but the missing high-frequency content is not uniquely determined by the low-resolution input. Consequently, visually plausible reconstructions may contain anatomically unsupported vascular detail, such as missing, spurious, or incorrectly connected vessels. To overcome this challenge, we introduce VascuSR, an iterative anatomy-aware diffusion framework that combines image reconstruction with explicit 3D vascular guidance. First, to provide richer anatomical guidance, we use an explicit 3D vascular representation that captures structural information beyond individual slices. This representation also simplifies vascular refinement by allowing a lightweight 3D generative refiner to focus on vascular structure rather than complex CT appearance. Second, to guide slice-wise SR, a lightweight anatomy controller injects the refined structure into the diffusion decoder, while iterative feedback updates this guidance from each new SR volume. On re-annotated MSD Task08 and HVM datasets, VascuSR outperforms interpolation and learning-based SR baselines in segmentation accuracy (Dice and clDice) and 3D vascular structure (connectivity and mean centerline distance), while maintaining image quality comparable to its SR backbone. Compared with learning-based baselines, VascuSR reduces class-averaged connected-component counts by over 20% on both datasets and mean centerline distance by over 10% on MSD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VascuSR：用显式 3D 血管表示加轻量 3D 生成细化器获得结构引导，由 anatomy controller 注入扩散解码器做逐层 CT 超分，并以迭代反馈从新生成的 SR 体积更新引导，在 MSD Task08 与 HVM 上改善分割与 3D 血管结构指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「生成→结构引导→再注入」的迭代反馈回路与结构化先验注入解码器的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的循环注入与推理状态更新提供方法线索；「视觉合理但解剖上无支持的细节」这一诊断设置也可供核查视觉证据筛选与幻觉式细节的评价设计。
